cards.name: cover
cards.headline:
Five good
things,
this week
cards.body: Screens are not the villain. Here is a week of proof.

cards.name: made
cards.headline:
Things built
on a screen
items: A stop motion film about a hedgehog, 41 seconds long
A birthday card designed for an abuela in Valencia
A song, badly, on a free app, at full volume

cards.name: photo
cards.slot: Photo of the printed star chart on the fridge
cards.caption: Week three, and it is still up there

cards.name: connection
cards.quote: She read to her grandmother, 1,200 miles away, for 20 minutes.
cards.attrib: That was a screen doing exactly what it should.

cards.name: outside
cards.body: Real world jobs ticked off this week across our house. Every one of them bought screen time that had already done its job.

cards.name: printable
cards.headline:
The star chart,
on paper
cards.body: Print it, put it on the fridge, and the arguing turns into a deal you both already made.

cards.name: ask
cards.headline: Keep this one
cards.save: Save it for the Saturday when it has all gone wrong by ten in the morning.
cards.send: Send it to the parent who thinks they are the only one.
